target.statement: AUC of the proposed lp-norm constrained one-class classifier fusion on the Banknotes dataset (D1) in the pure learning scenario, reported as 99.97 ± 0.0% in Table 2.

compute.basis: No code is released; the target requires reimplementing four one-class base learners (SVDD, GP, KPCA, GMM), score normalisation, and the Frank-Wolfe fusion algorithm, then running 10 random splits on a small UCI dataset (1372 samples, 4 features).

blockers: No code or configuration files are provided; all components must be reimplemented from the paper text.
Exact hyperparameter tuning (kernel widths, KPCA dimensions, p, rho) and the two-sided min-max score normalisation details are only partially specified, making exact numerical reproduction unlikely.
title: Lp-Norm Constrained One-Class Classifier Combination
